newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - HERMIS BANK GETS OKAY TO UP STAKE IN SIAULIU.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - HERMIS BANK GETS OKAY TO UP STAKE IN SIAULIU.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Thursday that it had given the green light to Hermis Bank's application to buy a controlling stake in Siauliu Bank.
"The board of the Bank of Lithuania issued permission to Hermis Bank to directly acquire and to manage the package of shares of Siauliu Bank," the central bank said in a statement.

"The possibilities for Hermis Bank to buy into Siualiu Bank will only be limited by the free capital at its disposal," the bank said, effectively giving Hermis Bank permission to buy a controlling stake.
The central bank said on Tuesday that Hermis Bank had applied to acquire 51 percent of the shares in Siauliu Bank.
The central bank added that Hermis Bank fulfilled all risk limit requirements and had free capital of 18.7 million litas.
Hermis Bank already holds a stake of 9.8 percent in Siauliu Bank.
Siauliu Bank's share capital is currently 20 million litas and last month it decided to boost the amount by 14 million litas.
Hermis Bank said on Wednesday that acquiring a majority stake in Siauliu Bank would give it better access to a potentially lucrative regional market.
The city of Siauliai is the site of a proposed free economic zone.
